description: Fires when column 2 is exactly two stones high with an opponent stone on top (row 1 of column 2 theirs, row 2 empty), strongest right after the opponent played it. My stones beside that empty cell (rows 1-3 of columns 1 and 3) raise it; opponent stones there, especially row 2 column 3, suppress it. Weak in the first few plies.
effect: Very small: zeroing it lowers column 2 by about 1-3 points and raises column 3 by 1-5 points; forcing it to max changes moves by <1 point.
notes: Gate alone (col2 height 2, O on top): F1 0.593, P 0.43, R 0.94, AUROC 0.95. Neighbour score (mine +1/theirs -1 on 6 cells around (2,2), +1 if last move col 2, -1 if ply<6, fire at >=0): F1 0.601, sim share 0.54. Minimal pairs confirm the gate (my stone on (2,2) -> -3.8; perspective flip -> 1.9) and the O-at-(2,3) suppression, but the threshold crossing among gate positions is noisy; synthesis peaks at 6.08 < dev max 6.61.
